sloka: हतमिन्द्रजितं दृष्ट्वा शयानं समरक्षितौ।राक्षसानां सहस्रेषु न कश्चित् प्रत्यदृश्यत ।। ६.९१.८३ ।।
transliteration: hatamindrajitaṁ dṛṣṭvā śayānaṁ samarakṣitau।rākṣasānāṁ sahasreṣu na kaścit pratyadṛśyata ।। 6.91.83 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith was lying, having fallen on the ground, and not even one of the thousands of Rakshasas was present there to see.
